title: Scenario summaries and complete morphology dimensions
transcriptionMethod: Manual transcription from Tables 2, 4, and 5 and Section 3.2.1, checked against rendered pages and layout-preserving text extraction. Every expanded field carries its own exact locator.
assumptions: The records report scenario-construction dimensions and source summaries, not probabilities or rankings.
Technology clusters containing multiple Table 4 rows preserve every distinct categorical value rather than choosing one row.
Figure 6 biosphere distributions remain not_transcribed until a separate graphical-transcription review is completed.
notes: The compact Table 5 construction fields remain for backwards-compatible story state; fieldProvenance and expanded morphology fields provide exact field-level locators.
